Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is A New Approach to Reasoning for?

Reasoning split by question type, each followed by a practice exercise - verbal, non-verbal and analytical in one book.

What does A New Approach to Reasoning cover?

Verbal, non-verbal and analytical reasoning organised by question type, with a practice exercise after each type and previous-year questions.

Which exams is A New Approach to Reasoning useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Patwari, Staff Selection Commission, Banking Exams, General competitive.
